text:
juan: Quick sync - onboarding reporting inconsistent errors in sample apps. TS throws structured errors, Go prints raw body. Need unified ergonomics.

li: Agreed. Users see "request failed" and don't know whether to retry.

noah: Can we standardize a tiny envelope: code (string), status (int), message (short), retryable (bool), retry_after (int seconds)?

maria: Yes. Also include a link in the message to the KB for auth/limits. One-liner messages only.

li: SDK mapping idea: map envelope to typed exceptions (RateLimitError, AuthError, BadRequestError) and expose `raw` for debugging.

noah: For headers: server should send Retry-After header + body field. SDKs prefer body.retry_after then header.

juan: Rollout plan: API adds envelope, SDKs parse behind feature flag, then enable by default after 2 weeks. Backcompat for scripts parsing raw body.

ci-bot: @noah CI (samples) failed: samples/api/map_error.ts missing export `mapApiError`. https://ci.redwood.internal/2345

maria: Action items: Noah/LI draft RFC for exception mapping and code enum; Juan update sample apps with small retry snippet; I'll update onboarding checklist + KB link.

li: I'll include short TS/Go snippets showing retry using `retry_after`.

juan: Thanks — this should cut a lot of early churn.
